title: Write phase a scaffold verification document
description:
Create docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md recording the exact commands executed for phase a and their real results. This is a documentation task: write down what actually happened, not what should happen.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt and CMakePresets.json for the frozen identity values and preset names.
- scripts/build_all.sh for the exact artifact paths it checks.
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp for the isBusesLayoutSupported contract and the deterministic output-channel clearing in processBlock.

Actually run these three commands from the repository root and capture their real output and exit statuses before writing:
1. cmake --preset linux-release
2. cmake --build build/linux-release
3. bash scripts/build_all.sh

The document must contain these sections in this order:
- '# Phase A Scaffold Verification' title.
- '## Product Identity' listing the frozen values as a table: plugin name ShredSpace, vendor nSpace Systems, version 1.0.0, manufacturer code NSPC, plugin code ShSp, bundle identifier com.nspacesystems.shredspace, LV2 URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace.
- '## Commands Executed' with each of the three commands in a fenced code block followed by its recorded exit status.
- '## Artifact Results' with one line per artifact (VST3, LV2, Standalone) giving the on-disk path and PASS or FAIL exactly as scripts/build_all.sh reported it.
- '## Bus Layout Contract' stating that mono-in/mono-out, mono-in/stereo-out, and stereo-in/stereo-out are the only supported layouts, and that processBlock clears every output channel beyond the input channel count before any processing.
- '## Notes' recording that the windows-msvc preset is configuration only and was not built in this plan, and that JUCE is a submodule pinned to 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2 and was not modified.

Do not invent output. If a command failed, record the failure and its exit status honestly. Do not include artist or song names anywhere in the document.
acceptance_criteria: docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md exists and begins with the heading '# Phase A Scaffold Verification'
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md contains sections titled 'Product Identity', 'Commands Executed', 'Artifact Results', 'Bus Layout Contract', and 'Notes'
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md lists the frozen identity values ShredSpace, nSpace Systems, 1.0.0, NSPC, ShSp, com.nspacesystems.shredspace, and urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md records the literal commands 'cmake --preset linux-release', 'cmake --build build/linux-release', and 'bash scripts/build_all.sh' with an exit status for each
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md records a PASS or FAIL and an on-disk path for each of the VST3, LV2, and Standalone artifacts
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md states the three supported bus layouts and the deterministic output-channel clearing rule
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md notes that windows-msvc is configuration only and that JUCE is pinned to 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2 and unmodified
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md contains no artist or song names
docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md is the only file created or modified by this task
forbidden_changes: create or modify any file under JUCE/
fabricate command output or exit statuses that were not actually observed
create additional documentation files outside docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md

allowed: choose markdown table formatting and code-fence language hints
choose the wording of narrative sentences within the required sections
forbidden: omit any of the six required sections
record results for commands that were not run
modify source or build files to make the document's claims true
